S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  CRLA No.323 of 2024  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Prabhakar Joshi, learned legal-aid counsel for the appellant.
2. Mr. J.S. Virk, learned D.A.G. along with Mr. Rakesh Joshi, learned Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. This is an appeal against conviction filed by the appellant under Section 374(2) of Cr.P.C.

By the impugned judgment dated 14.05.2024 passed by learned F.T.C./ Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO), Udham Singh Nagar in Special Sessions Trial No.163 of 2021, appellant was convicted for offence punishable under Sections 376(3), 504, 506 IPC and Section 5(m)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO), 2012, vide and was sentenced to 20 years' rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.30,000/-.
4.
